question: Where exactly is the Cube Guest House located in Hout Bay?
answer: Our Cube Guest House is situated in a wonderfully quiet location on a hillside in an upscale residential area of Hout Bay.

question: Is the Cube Guest House a good starting point for excursions to Cape Town?
answer: Definitely, our location combines the quiet flair of Hout Bay with excellent transport connections. You can reach the center of Cape Town by car in about 20 minutes. The airport, world-famous beaches, and renowned wine-growing regions are also strategically located for day trips.

question: How far is the Cube Guest House from the beach in Hout Bay?
answer: The fine sandy beach and the picturesque fishing harbor are only three kilometers away from our accommodation. This short distance can be easily covered in a few minutes by rental car or a ride service.

question: What kind of view can I expect from the Hout Bay Guest House?
answer: Thanks to the slightly elevated hillside location, many of our rooms offer spectacular panoramic views. You often look directly out to the open sea as well as the majestic mountain peaks, most notably the famous "Chapman's Peak". This backdrop makes every evening on the terrace an unforgettable experience.

question: Is breakfast included in the price for the Cube Guest House?
answer: Yes, a rich breakfast is always included in the room rate. We serve it every morning on our large sun terrace right by the pool area. Look forward to crispy bread rolls, homemade jam, various egg dishes, fresh fruit, juices, as well as excellent coffee and tea specialties. We are, of course, very happy to accommodate special dietary requirements upon prior request.

question: Is there a pool area at the Hout Bay Guest House?
answer: Absolutely, our solar-heated outdoor pool is the centerpiece of our extensive gardens. It invites you to take a refreshing dip after a long day of excursions in the Cape region.

question: Does the Guest House in Hout Bay offer secure parking?
answer: Yes, free parking spaces are available to our guests directly on our secure property.

question: Is free Wi-Fi offered at the Cube Guest House?
answer: Fast, free internet is available throughout the entire property. This allows you to relax by the pool at any time while sharing your holiday photos from South Africa with those back home.

question: Will I be personally looked after by the hosts at the Hout Bay Guest House?
answer: Warm hospitality is very important to us, which is why we place enormous value on a personal and familiar atmosphere. We are always by your side, whether you need a table reservation at a nearby restaurant or advice on planning your next hike. Our ultimate goal is to pamper you completely throughout your entire holiday.

question: What room categories does the Hout Bay Guest House offer?
answer: We offer five individually and modernly furnished rooms that are suitable for every occasion. These include our spacious Corner Suite, the elegant Cosmopolitan Suite, and the cozy Courtyard Room. Each guest room exudes its very own charm and differs in size and layout. If needed, we are also very happy to advise you in advance on choosing the perfect accommodation for your stay in South Africa.

question: How are the rooms at the Cube Guest House equipped?
answer: All our rooms are equipped with the highest level of comfort to make your stay as pleasant as possible. In every room, you will find a well-stocked minibar, a Nespresso coffee machine, and a flat-screen TV with Netflix access. High-quality beds, made with the finest Egyptian cotton bed linen, ensure a deep and restful night's sleep. Exclusive toiletries and fluffy bathrobes complete the luxurious experience in the en-suite bathrooms. Furthermore, almost all our rooms have access to their own private terrace.

question: Do the rooms at the Hout Bay Guest House have air conditioning?
answer: Selected room categories, such as our luxurious Corner Suite, the Cosmopolitan Suite, and the Comb View Room, are equipped with modern air conditioning.
